title.text: Get started: the screen after Welcome

flutter.text:
For the Flutter build

• Opens from Welcome's Get started. The a leaves the doorway and glides up to the right of the headline on one curve (0.85 s); the headline, line, field and buttons rise in after it.
• The a listens: its eyes move right as digits land. 10 valid digits → happy. Starts with 0–5 → worried. Sending → looks up.
• Field: +91 fixed, 10 digits shown as 98765 43210. Paste with +91, 91 or a leading 0 is cleaned (GI-20, GI-22).
• Send code turns vermilion only for a valid number; one tap sends once (GI-24).
• Keyboard open: Send code always sits above it. On short phones the line hides and the a moves into the top bar (GI-63).
• Offline: dark strip, both buttons off (GI-12).
• Colours and type: kp.css (paper #FBF7EF, ink #1A1410, vermilion #C8302B, Anek Latin).
